query:
UPDATE projects 
SET 
  description = 'Red Bull Jukebox transformed Nashville''s Ascend Amphitheater into an interactive music experience where 6,800 fans controlled the setlist in real-time. Working with Lumenati, we delivered the complete technical translation and CNC fabrication documentation for this groundbreaking event—from concept to construction-ready files.

The Challenge: Transform an ambitious stage concept featuring a monumental LED arch and layered scenic facades into precision-engineered, fabrication-ready components. Every element needed to integrate seamlessly with LED content, truss systems, and venue infrastructure while maintaining visual impact at scale.

Our Solution: We developed comprehensive CNC documentation in Vectorworks, breaking complex geometries into repeatable, transportable panels. Each component was engineered for efficient routing, assembly, and structural integration—coordinating arc radii, connection points, and tolerances across curved surfaces. Material specifications aligned with LED requirements and truss mounting systems.

The Result: A complete set of fabrication-ready CNC drawings that enabled efficient production and flawless on-site assembly. The installation framed Brothers Osborne, Shaboozey, and an all-star lineup in a visually stunning environment that brought Red Bull''s interactive vision to life.',
  designNotes = 'Red Bull Jukebox represented a unique convergence of experiential design, live entertainment, and fan interaction. Our role focused on translating creative vision into buildable reality.

We analyzed the original stage concept and developed detailed CNC drawings for large-scale steel and aluminum construction. The primary scenic elements—a monumental LED wall arch and multiple layered façade components—required precise segmentation to accommodate CNC cutting, transportation, and on-site assembly.

Using Vectorworks, we created elevation, section, and CNC layout drawings that provided clear fabrication instructions. Each component was labeled, dimensioned, and sequenced to support efficient CNC routing and assembly. We coordinated material specifications (aluminum and MDF applications) with structural requirements and LED integration needs.

Collaboration with fabricators and trussing partners ensured the CNC files interfaced cleanly with truss systems. Human-scale references embedded in the drawings verified proportion and sightline impact within the venue.

The project emphasized precision, clarity, and buildability—ensuring the final installation could be realized efficiently while preserving the scale and impact of the original concept.',
  metadata = JSON_SET(
    metadata,
    '$.redBullLogo', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/PJCPPGDGlbyyCuvu.png'
  )
WHERE slug = 'red-bull-jukebox';
